title: 第9章 带你赚到灵石了你哭什么第10章 女帝大人您跟沈浪学坏了呀
slug: 提蓝桥刚毕业女帝求我当宰相
content_zh:
;;
“老爷，请开始你的表演吧！”
眼见神霄竟然真的加入了这场闹剧，上官冉也兴奋了起来。
她看中一颗丹药已经很久了，就差一千枚灵石。
如今只要赢了沈浪，那颗丹药就有着落了。
殊不知。
从她答应跟沈浪对赌开始，就已经输了！
“娘子，给她拿一件普通的衣服，让她换上！”
“好！”
神霄倒是没有迟疑，轻车熟路的回屋，找了件失忆时间穿的旧衣服递给了上官冉。
上官冉也没墨迹，三下五除二，便将普通的服装，穿在了身上。
这才玩味至极道：“老爷，您该不会是带着我去乞讨吧？”
“我可提醒您，乞讨可赚不到灵石！”
“放心吧，你家老爷我，未来是当宰相的，怎么可能去做那等工作？”
“你跟我来，待会别说话，就会有人把一百枚灵石送给你了！”
眼见沈浪说的还挺像那么一回事，上官冉一脸冷笑的跟着沈浪走了出去。
而神霄也是麻溜的将沈浪撰写的横渠四句，小心翼翼的收好，跟了上去。
半炷香后。
神霄见到沈浪还在路上走，也是忍不住的询问：“相公，你到底能不能成啊？
“要是不能，我给你个台阶下，这件事就这么算了吧！”

“你傻逼吗？”沈浪恨铁不成钢道：“白捡的钱不要？”
神霄：“……”
她觉得她要是再劝沈浪，就抽自己两嘴巴。
就该让沈浪吃些苦头，让他知道，就算是被仙人点化过，在大乾王朝也得夹起尾巴做人。
就在神霄盘算着，待会沈浪完不成赌约，自己应该怎么教育他时……
沈浪在一个宅院外，停下了脚步道：“你站在这里等我，我进去买个橘子，待会就有人来给你灵石了！”
“买个橘子？”
上官冉一脸错愕道：“买橘子到这里买？”
“你废话怎么那么多，还踏马赌不赌了？”沈浪板起脸。
“赌，你快去买橘子吧！”上官冉挺直腰杆。
沈浪见状，也是强忍着笑意，敲响了宅院的门。
很快，一位老者便是露出半个脑袋道：“干什么的？”
面对老者询问，沈浪嘿嘿一笑：“忽悠了一个傻丫头，寻思着换点灵石花花！”
“哦？”
老者闻言，下意识的看向沈浪手指着的方向。
当看到上官冉那普通的衣服下，也难掩的傲人身姿时……
content_en:
;;
"Master, please start your performance!"
Seeing that Shen Xiao actually joined in the farce, Shangguan Ran also became excited.
She has been eyeing a pill for a long time, and is only short of a thousand spiritual stones.
Now as long as he defeats Shen Lang, the elixir will be available.
Little did I know.
Ever since she agreed to bet with Shen Lang, she had already lost!
"Madam, get her some ordinary clothes and let her change into them!"
"Okay!"
Shen Xiao didn't hesitate, and walked back to the house with ease, found an old piece of clothing he wore when he lost his memory, and handed it to Shangguan Ran.
Shangguan Ran didn't have any ink marks, so he put on ordinary clothes.
Then he said with great interest: "Master, are you taking me to beg?"
"Let me remind you, you can't earn spiritual stones by begging!"
"Don't worry, your master and I will be the prime minister in the future. How can I do such a job?"
"Come with me, don't talk for a while, and someone will give you a hundred spiritual stones!"
Seeing that Shen Lang said something quite similar, Shangguan Ran followed Shen Lang out with a sneer on his face.
And Shenxiao also quickly put away the four sentences of Hengqu written by Shen Lang and followed.
After half a stick of incense.
When Shen Xiao saw Shen Lang still walking on the road, he couldn't help but ask: "My husband, can you make it?"
"If you can't, I'll give you a step down and let this matter go! "
"Are you stupid? Shen Lang hated the iron and said, "You don't want the money you picked up for free?" "
Shen Xiao: "..."
She felt that if she tried to persuade Shen Lang again, she would slap herself twice.
Shen Lang should be made to suffer some hardships and let him know that even if he was enlightened by an immortal, he still had to keep his tail between his legs in the Daqian Dynasty.
Just when Shen Xiao was thinking about how he should educate Shen Lang if he failed to fulfill his bet...
Shen Lang stopped outside a house and said, "You stand here and wait for me, I'll go in and buy an orange, and someone will come to give you the spirit stone later!" "
"Buy an orange? "
Shangguan Ran said with a look of astonishment: "Buy oranges here? "
"Why do you talk so much nonsense and why don't you bet on your horse? "Shen Lang made a serious face.
“Bet, go buy oranges quickly! "Shangguan Ran straightened his back.
When Shen Lang saw this, he suppressed a smile and knocked on the door of the house.
Soon, an old man revealed half of his head and said, "What are you doing? "
Facing the old man's question, Shen Lang chuckled: "I fooled a silly girl, thinking about changing to some spiritual stones! "
"oh? "
Hearing this, the old man subconsciously looked in the direction pointed by Shen Lang's finger.
When I saw Shangguan Ran's proud figure that could not be concealed under his ordinary clothes...
